sources.shortSummary: Push protection blocks detected secrets before upload. Repository and user protection differ in enablement, scope, bypass alerts, and auditability; GitHub MCP coverage is public-repository-specific.

sources.title: Customize agent workflows with hooks
sources.shortSummary: Repository hooks use version 1 JSON in .github/hooks on the default branch, camelCase event keys, operating-system-specific commands, timeouts, and compact JSON output. Training pseudocode is not the hook schema.

sources.title: Managing agent sessions
sources.shortSummary: Session logs correlate commits and decisions; steering, stopping, archiving, sharing, and context handoff have distinct semantics. Stopping preserves pushed commits; no hot replacement guarantee is documented.

sources.title: Customizing or disabling the firewall for GitHub Copilot
sources.shortSummary: Cloud-agent and code-review firewall controls support organization/repository settings and domain or path-restricted URLs. Blocked-address warnings support failure diagnosis. Scope excludes MCP servers and setup-step processes; the firewall is not a complete exfiltration defense.

sources.title: Review output from Copilot
sources.shortSummary: Copilot output needs human review, required-approval independence, and by-default approval before privileged Actions runs; current documentation allows administrators to configure automatic runs.

sources.title: Creating rulesets for a repository
sources.shortSummary: Ruleset creation, targeting, permission requirements, active/disabled enforcement, and pull-request-only bypass paths establish repository governance boundaries.

sources.title: About code owners
sources.shortSummary: CODEOWNERS review routing, explicit write access, base-branch selection, file precedence, last-match behavior, and required-review configuration.

sources.title: Audit log for an enterprise
sources.shortSummary: Enterprise Cloud audit logs identify actors and actions and support time-bounded retention, searching, exports, and streaming for enterprise owners.

sources.title: About GitHub Copilot cloud agent
sources.shortSummary: Cloud-agent execution environments, entrypoint-dependent PR creation, scope, concurrency limits, timeouts, metrics, and paid-plan/policy eligibility. The page mixes established features with explicitly Preview integrations and Memory; only those subfeatures should be labeled Preview in claims.

sources.title: Application card: GitHub Copilot Agents
sources.shortSummary: Official application card describes agent, CLI, and SDK capabilities, limitations, human accountability, and evaluation signals. Limitations are experience-specific; do not generalize CLI permission prompts or cloud repository-context access beyond dedicated current documentation.

sources.title: Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions
sources.shortSummary: Bounded review of workflow/job permissions and concurrency: unspecified scopes become none; commit statuses have their own scope; concurrency groups serialize work and have explicit cancellation/queue semantics. Other sections are not blanket-approved by this registry.

sources.title: Events that trigger workflows
sources.shortSummary: Bounded review of GITHUB_TOKEN-generated events: pull_request opened/synchronize/reopened can create approval-required runs; workflow_dispatch and repository_dispatch are exceptions to suppression of other token-generated workflow events. Do not repeat older blanket no-trigger claims.

sources.title: Using the GitHub MCP Server in your IDE
sources.shortSummary: GitHub MCP in supported IDEs, inherited feature licensing, managed MCP policy, tool permissions, and authorization/log troubleshooting.

sources.title: Configure an MCP registry for your organization or enterprise
sources.shortSummary: Preview registry configuration requires v0.1 HTTPS endpoints, CORS, and correct local-server IDs; Azure API Center needs anonymous discovery. The page states a separate managed-settings allowlist is GA but its deeper page is not independently admitted by this registry.

sources.title: Restrict MCP server access to a custom registry
sources.shortSummary: Preview registry-based allowlisting uses enterprise/organization policies, Allow all or Registry only, and API Center workspace base URLs without the automatically appended v0.1 suffix.
